Good guide on how to properly size the solar system needed to power you.

This is a great guide and has helped me better understand what I need and I wanted to share it as well. Solar energy is great and the cost is MUCH more affordable than it was even just a few years ago. Not uncommon to find panels for less than $1/watt and batteries have not only come down in price but made other more expensive options more affordable.

I'm currently using this guide to build out a solar system to power my home office where I am located now, which in an essence is practice towards building a much larger system for a house I am building in the desert.

If you can connect to your local grid it's going to be much cheaper to do so. But for those of us who can not due to unavailibility, want a backup power source or want to offset their electrical costs (even if the equipment to do is pricey and would take years to pay for itself) then solar is fun.

What simple changes can we make to improve our quality of life?

Sleep hygiene, exercise and drinking more water.

The difference these three things makes is IMMENSE. Depression will get better, pains will go away, headaches will stop... unless you have a really bad underlying medical condition.
Spend time with yourself, I find it relaxing.

Well there's the obvious including:

  • Eating better
  • Trying new food and/or recipes daily
  • Going on daily walks by yourself
  • Exercise in general

And then there's other things that are entirely optional but may be beneficial to you. Such as:

  • Unplugging for at least one day a week. Give your mind a break from electronics and relax.
  • Taking up a new hobby that's both relaxing and makes you happy, this makes you less stressed and at the same time it increases your productivity.
  • Trying something new at least once a month.
The most important thing is to stay well rested. Change your diet to something healthier and exercise for at least 30 minutes a day.

Detailed demonstration of an easy to build rainwater catchment filteration system for your off grid home.

Well, the house in the video isn't off grid but it's the best quality and easiest to follow demonstration of a filteration system that can be easily built and integrated to your off grid homestead. It consists mainly of simply and affordable PVC piping from your local friendly hardware store, valves, filters and pumps. The end result is water safe to drink and cook with that you captured from the sky above you and have been storing in your catchment storage tank(s).
